name: Spell Backfired
variants: Your {category} ritual fizzled after {length} days. Eyebrows mostly intact.
The {category} enchantment held for {length} days, then hiccupped. Even archmages sneeze mid-incantation.
After {length} days, your {category} spell ended in a small puff of purple smoke. Very dignified, all things considered.
Professor's note: {length} days of {category} is proper magic. Cauldrons boil over; it is what they are for.
restart: Chalk a fresh circle and cast again.
